name: New Looney Tunes
description: Wabbit is an animated series starring Bugs Bunny. The series features many other Looney Tunes characters including Wile E. Coyote, Yosemite Sam, and the Tasmanian Devil.

credits_cast.character: Bugs Bunny / Elmer Fudd / Foghorn Leghorn / Sylvester (voice)
credits_cast.name: Jeff Bergman
